Please note: this vacancy is only open to candidates who have the legal right to work in the Netherlands and are currently enrolled in a study program relevant to the role.About us:Welcome to Crowne Plaza Amsterdam – South, a modern business hotel in the lively Zuidas district.
With 207 rooms, 7 meeting venues, and buzzing spots like De Japanner Zuid and the Manhattan Lounge-Bar, we offer guests and team members a place to connect, grow, and belong — as part of the global IHG Hotels & Resorts family.Your day to day:
• Assist in planning, organizing, and executing various meetings and events.
• Help maintain relationships with clients and following up in current business.
• Attend regular team meetings to discuss ongoing and upcoming events, providing updates on current business and any challenges encountered.
• Contribute suggestions based on your observations and interactions with clients to enhance event planning processes.
• Assist with invoicing and post-event evaluations to ensure client satisfaction.
• Collaborate with various departments, including banqueting and front desk to guarantee successful event execution.
• Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in event management.
• Participate in brainstorming sessions to develop innovative ideas for events and promotions.
• Collaborate with team members to analyze event feedback, helping to identify areas for improvement in service delivery.
• Assist in the preparation of meeting agendas and take detailed minutes, ensuring all action items are documented and followed up on in a timely manner.
